evals.prompt: 用 Python + iv8 跑京东 h5st，页码、pageSize、UA 都写在代码顶部，PyCharm 直接运行后 requests 请求接口并打印完整响应。
evals.expected_output: 应生成紧凑 Python 主脚本，按实际重复度决定是否拆出 utils helper；参考 jd-h5st 案例，顶部保留可编辑常量，动态素材写入 js_reverse_cache，并至少执行 py_compile。
expectations: The response uses Python with iv8 and requests or curl_cffi.requests for a real HTTP request
The response uses utils helpers only when they reduce real duplication; a clear single-file implementation is acceptable
The response keeps editable constants such as PAGE_SIZE, START_PAGE, UA, PAGE_URL, or API_URL at the top of the script
The response stores downloaded or generated runtime materials under the workspace js_reverse_cache directory

evals.prompt: API 先返回 seed/name/ts，需要参考 zhipin-stoken.py 用 iv8 算 __zp_stoken__ cookie，再用同一个 requests.Session 重试接口。
evals.expected_output: 应选择 browser-token/challenge-token 路线，保持同一 Session，iv8 计算 token/cookie 后回写 cookie jar 并重试真实请求。
expectations: The response selects the bundled zhipin-stoken style case or equivalent browser-token route
The response keeps cookie, token, timestamp, and retry request in the same requests.Session
The response does not switch to the Trace Node.js env-patch profile or plain entry tracing as the main solution

evals.prompt: 瑞数后缀请求已经确认要走 iv8，帮我触发页面里的 XHR，从 iv8 netLog 取最终 URL、headers、cookieHeader 后用 requests 重放。
evals.expected_output: 应选择 Ruishu-style XHR suffix capture 路线，参考 chinatax/customs 案例，在 iv8 内触发 XHR，读取 netLog 后 Python 重放。
expectations: The response treats this as an iv8 runtime reproduction rather than a fixed Node scaffold task
The response reads final URL, headers, cookieHeader, or body metadata from iv8 netLog
The response replays the captured request with Python requests or curl_cffi.requests

evals.prompt: 普通接口 403，还不知道是什么防护。先帮我找 x-sign 入口和调用链，不要写 iv8 脚本。
evals.expected_output: 不应触发 iv8-web-reverse 主流程，应返回 Trace Observe/Capture 做入口定位或路线判断。
expectations: The response does not create a Python iv8 script before the deliverable is confirmed
The response hands off to Trace Observe/Capture or states that entry/location work should happen first

evals.prompt: 把这段依赖 window/document/navigator 的 JS 放到 Node VM 里补环境跑通，入口函数已经知道，不要 iv8。
evals.expected_output: 不应触发 iv8-web-reverse，应转 trace env-patch profile，因为交付目标是 Node.js/VM 补环境。
expectations: The response does not use iv8 as the main runtime
The response identifies this as Node.js or VM environment patching
The response hands off to the trace env-patch profile or follows its run-diagnose-patch-verify loop

evals.prompt: 这次 iv8 复现已经跑通了，帮我把脚本脱敏后回写成 skill 里的 bundled case，素材放到 references/cases/js_reverse_cache/<site-slug>/。
evals.expected_output: 应进入案例回写模式，读取 case-ingestion-rules，只复制脱敏后的最小脚本和 frozen 素材，更新 taxonomy，不保存账号 Cookie 或完整响应。
expectations: The response recognizes explicit bundled-case backfill mode
The response follows case-ingestion-rules and writes frozen assets under references/cases/js_reverse_cache/<site-slug>/
The response excludes credentials, personal tokens, full business responses, and one-off capture artifacts

evals.prompt: 这个站首包返回 Incapsula 页面，脚本会先 POST {"f":"gpc"}，再发送 solution.interrogation.p/st/sr/cr/og，帮我用 Python+iv8 动态生成 reese84 并请求业务 API。
evals.expected_output: 应进入 Reese84 profile，建立同 session 的纯协议 collector，并以业务 API 成功作为最终验证。
expectations: The response declares one coherent browser baseline and a browser-free final runtime
The response dynamically discovers and downloads the current challenge instead of freezing a script or token
The Python session performs real HTTP while iv8 executes the challenge
The response validates the protected page or business API rather than only the token endpoint

evals.prompt: reese84 token 接口已经 200 且返回 token，但带上后页面还是 403。iv8 里 p 是 bin1，怎么系统排查？
evals.expected_output: 应按 Reese84 profile 的跨层身份、宿主泄漏、iframe、Canvas、Cookie 和 UTMVC 优先级做单变量诊断。
expectations: The response states that receiving a token does not prove admission
The response compares UA, Client Hints, JS environment, and curl_cffi impersonation first
The response checks host leakage in the main and iframe realms
The response does not treat p length as a correctness criterion

evals.prompt: 我抓到了 Chrome 150 的 Reese84 成功包，但本地 iv8 用的是 Firefox Canvas 和 Chrome UA。请修成可重复的 collector。
evals.expected_output: 应拒绝跨浏览器混拼，选择一个 Chromium baseline 并重新采集 coherent 环境。
expectations: The response identifies Firefox Canvas with Chrome UA as an invalid mixed baseline
The response recaptures same-source Canvas pixels and encoded image outputs
The response aligns HTTP UA, Client Hints, JS UA, and transport profile
The response requires at least two fresh-session validations

evals.prompt: 动态 Reese84 已通过，下一步把抓包 curl 的业务 JSON URL、Referer 和 fetch headers 接进去，不能复用抓包 Cookie。
evals.expected_output: 应在同一个通过挑战的 curl_cffi Session 中动态请求业务资源并保存响应。
expectations: The response does not copy a frozen Cookie header
The response reuses the collector's curl_cffi Session
The response keeps UA, Client Hints, and transport coherent
The response saves status, content type, byte length, and parsed data

evals.prompt: 已经确认页面在生成 reese84，但没有任何成功浏览器抓包，challenge 还是从独立 CDN 加载的，应该怎么开始？
evals.expected_output: 应接受显式 Reese84 证据，建立受限跨域 allowlist 和单一 provisional baseline，并明确验证缺口。
expectations: The response does not reject an explicit Reese84 marker merely because an accepted baseline is missing
The response neither allows nor blocks every cross-origin challenge unconditionally
The response installs core host-hiding, error, and network bridges before page.load
The response does not claim completion before protected business admission succeeds

evals.prompt: 做一个长期运行的 Reese84 collector，服务端会返回 renewInSec，多个 worker 要持续请求业务接口。
evals.expected_output: 应设计有安全余量、受保护资源验证、失败全量重建且 worker session 隔离的续期策略。
expectations: The response records token acquisition time and renewInSec
The response validates renewal against a protected resource rather than only the token response
The response performs a full bootstrap and challenge after renewal failure
Workers do not share a mutable Cookie jar

evals.prompt: 串行 Reese84 已经稳定成功，现在要并发 2 个 worker。ThreadPoolExecutor 里出现 EventTarget.addEventListener Illegal invocation，应该怎么实现和验证？
evals.expected_output: 应识别 iv8 同进程线程安全问题，改用 spawn 多进程，每个 worker 隔离 runtime、Session 和 Cookie，并分两阶段验证 Reese 与业务 API。
expectations: The response forbids ThreadPoolExecutor for parallel iv8 JSContext execution
The response uses ProcessPoolExecutor with multiprocessing spawn
Each process creates its own collector, Session, Cookie jar, and iv8 runtime
The response first validates two Reese workers and then two Reese plus business-API workers
Aggregated results do not print or return complete tokens or cookies

evals.prompt: 已经确认 Reese84，challenge 能执行，但第一步 {"f":"gpc"} 返回 403，响应有 cf-mitigated: challenge。recovery HTML 里还有 window.__CF$cv$params 和 challenge-platform precursor main.js。怎么做 browser-free 全链？
evals.expected_output: 应先把 Cloudflare precursor 建模为 GPC 前的独立 edge admission，用同一 curl_cffi Session 动态执行当轮脚本并获得 clearance，reload 后再进入 Reese；不得继续盲补 Canvas，也不得依赖随机闭包短变量名。
expectations: The response identifies Cloudflare edge admission as the earliest failing layer before Reese GPC
The response dynamically fetches and executes the current precursor script in a separate bounded iv8 context while reusing the same Python Session
The response does not copy a browser cf_clearance or freeze a precursor URL, ray, body, or closure function name
The response distinguishes recognized precursor from a generic full Managed Challenge and hands the latter to Trace
The response validates GPC, solution, replay, and business admission after clearance rather than treating the clearance cookie as success

evals.prompt: 首跳 POST 返回 Aliyun WAF challenge HTML，成功请求的 URL 多出长 md5__1803，入口函数在闭包里，要求用 Python + iv8 + requests 做无浏览器回放。
evals.expected_output: 应读取 cdfsunrise-md5-1803 reverse-process，先用同一 requests.Session 获取 fresh challenge，再用 iv8 page.load 执行 WAF，静态确认 Lf/LK 参数顺序，处理源码自校验，生成完整签名 URL，最后以 application/json 和 responseHead.code=0 验收。
expectations: The response selects iv8-web-reverse as the runtime owner
The response distinguishes the WAF md5__1803 URL signature from a business short sign
The response keeps challenge, cookie, body, and replay in one requests.Session
The response treats closure-scoped LK and Function.prototype.toString checks as first-class constraints
The response validates business JSON and code 0 rather than only HTTP 200

evals.prompt: 普通 403，只想用 AST 找出闭包里的 LK 和调用链，暂时不要执行 challenge，也不要写 requests + iv8 回放脚本。
evals.expected_output: 不应直接进入 iv8-web-reverse 的 Port 交付；应转 Trace AST/Observe 阶段，只输出入口、依赖和证据，不生成最终回放脚本。
expectations: The response treats AST-only entry discovery as Trace-owned evidence work
The response does not claim a pure protocol replay is ready
The response does not create a full iv8 requests replay before the entry and protocol deliverable are requested
